subscriptions.title: Detected subscriptions
subscriptions.error: Could not create the recurring item
subscriptions.info: We look at the last 12 months for charges from the same merchant, with practically the same amount (±2%), repeating monthly at least 3 times (weekly, 4 times) and still active. "Create recurring" will generate it automatically each month without duplicating this month's charge. The X hides it from this list on this device.

petty.info: Adds up expenses of €10 or less from the last 30 days, excluding recurring items and goal contributions. The yearly estimate is that total × 12. It shows how much goes on coffee, snacks and small purchases.
